subject.title: normalizeGitHubActor: not idempotent — strips only one trailing [bot]

question: Should requester grouping collapse every repeated trailing `[bot]` suffix while mutation authorization continues comparing the submitted actor exactly?
rationale: The change is mechanically small but affects identity canonicalization next to an authorization boundary, and the latest human discussion explicitly reserves the intended behavior for deliberate review.

options.title: Normalize grouping only
options.body: Accept repeated-suffix stripping in `normalizeGitHubActor` while retaining raw exact checks in mutation authorization and the focused authorization regression tests.

options.title: Preserve single stripping
options.body: Keep the current helper behavior and treat repeated suffixes as malformed inputs that are not fully canonicalized.

recommendation.title: Normalize grouping only
recommendation.body: Accept repeated-suffix stripping in `normalizeGitHubActor` while retaining raw exact checks in mutation authorization and the focused authorization regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the clearest current human direction for reviewing this authorization-adjacent behavior.
